title: A $90 Key into Your Company's Secrets
summary: The cost of an autonomous 32-step corporate break-in fell 99% in five months from $7,500 on Claude Mythos Preview in April 2026 to $90 on open-weight GLM-5.3. Attackers run an expected-value calculation on AI compute ($1m of compute for a 1% shot at a $1b payout yields $10m in expected value), while defenders must maximize security effectiveness across speed (responding in minutes or seconds), scale (parallel agent swarms), & breadth (82-to-1 non-human identities).

title: Watts in Store for 2027 : The AI Ceiling
summary: US AI capacity grows from 38gw today to an 81gw ceiling in 2027. Because 40% of compute serves inference & new Blackwell & Rubin racks lift blended monetization from $9.4b to $15.1b per inference gigawatt, theoretical US inference revenue rises 3.4x from $0.14t to $0.49t.
